en.hubeali: H 14734 – A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Maalik bin Atiyya, who has narrated the following: Some of the companions of Abu Abdullahasws has reported that Abu Abdullahasws came out to us and heasws was ‘مُغْضَبٌ’ angry.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘I<sup>asws</sup> went out for some need, so some black people of Al-Medina presented themselves to me<sup>asws</sup>.
They shouted at me<sup>asws</sup> as: ‘لَبَّيْكَ يَا جَعْفَرَ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ لَبَّيْكَ’  ‘Here I am (Labbaik) O Ja’far Bin Muhammad<sup>asws</sup>, here I am (Labbaik)!’

So I<sup>asws</sup> returned back to my<sup>asws</sup> house, in a fearful panic from what they had said, until I<sup>asws</sup> prostrated to my<sup>asws</sup> Lord<sup>azwj</sup> and rubbed my<sup>asws</sup> face to Him<sup>azwj</sup>, and humbled myself<sup>asws</sup> to Him<sup>azwj</sup>, and distanced myself<sup>asws</sup> (from them) to Him<sup>azwj</sup> from what they had shouted to me<sup>asws</sup>.

And if Isa<sup>as</sup> Ibn Maryam<sup>as</sup> had added anything to what Allah<sup>azwj</sup> had Said regarding him<sup>as</sup>, then he<sup>as</sup> would have become deaf and would not have been able to hear anything after that ever, and become blinded and would not have been able to visualise anything after that ever, and would have become dumb and would not have been able to speak anything after that ever’.
Then heasws said: ‘May Allahazwj Curse Abu Al-Khattaab and kill him with the iron’[25].
en.sarwar: 286. A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Maalik bin Atiyya, who has narrated the following: Some of the companions of Abu Abdullah (a.s.) has reported that Abu Abdullah (a.s.) came out to us and he (a.s.) was ‘مُغْضَبٌ’ angry.
He (a.s.) said: ‘I (a.s.) went out for some need, so some black people of Al-Medina presented themselves to me (a.s.).
They shouted at me (a.s.) as: ‘لَبَّيْكَ يَا جَعْفَرَ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ لَبَّيْكَ’ ‘Here I am (Labbaik) O Ja’far Bin Muhammad (a.s.), here I am (Labbaik)!’

So I (a.s.) returned back to my (a.s.) house, in a fearful panic from what they had said, until I (a.s.) prostrated to my (a.s.) Lord (azwj) and rubbed my (a.s.) face to Him (azwj), and humbled myself (a.s.) to Him (azwj), and distanced myself (a.s.) (from them) to Him (azwj) from what they had shouted to me (a.s.).

And if Isa (as) Ibn Maryam (as) had added anything to what Allah (azwj) had Said regarding him (as), then he (as) would have become deaf and would not have been able to hear anything after that ever, and become blinded and would not have been able to visualise anything after that ever, and would have become dumb and would not have been able to speak anything after that ever’.
Then he (a.s.) said: ‘May Allah (azwj) Curse Abu Al-Khattaab and kill him with the iron’.
